# tapectl status

[All commands](README.md)

What is running and how the last sessions ended, from the session logs alone: the live session's phase, progress, rate and ETA, and each recent session's outcome and phase timings. Opens no catalog and no config, so an account in the home's `[ops] group` can run it (`tapectl --home <service home> status`) without sudo

```text
tapectl status [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- `--last <LAST>` *(default: `5`)* — How many finished sessions to show, newest first (running ones are always shown)
